query: PR #212 on the API repo is merged. A review bot flagged an ordering race we fixed in 3f2a1c, and the implementer had to stop twice to ask about the dedup marker. Crystallize it.
expected_output: Reads the PR diff and every review thread with its resolution; patches the closest umbrella skill with the ordering gotcha and adds an eval case; adds a dated declarative fact to the API role's memory store if it applies to every future task; records both questions as roast misses; writes docs/crystallize/<date>-api-pr212.md and opens a crystallize PR; summarises created/patched items in one screen.

expectations.text: Fetches the PR's review threads and uses their resolutions as signals
Patches an existing skill rather than creating a narrow new one, and adds an eval case for it
Any memory entry is a dated declarative fact within the cap, not a narrative
A report is written under docs/crystallize/ and a PR opened
Does not modify hooks, settings, engine code, or agent invariants

query: The mobile implementer just reported DONE on issue 640. Capture the learnings now, before the PR.
expected_output: Crystallize runs after the PR exists and its threads are settled (or after merge), because the review threads are its main input. Proceed to review and PR first; crystallize afterwards.

expectations.text: Declines to crystallize before the PR exists and explains that review threads are the input
No skill or memory file is written

query: Crystallize infra PR #77. The only review comment was a human noting that our retention doc still describes the old cleanup worker, but the code has used native TTL for months. Nothing else notable.
expected_output: Identifies a docs-drift signal: updates the retention document to match the code and records it under 'Docs synced'; judges that no new procedure or fact warrants a skill or memory change and says so under 'Declined, and why'; still writes the report and opens the PR.

expectations.text: Fixes the drifted doc to match the code, treating code as the source of truth
Explicitly reports that no skill or memory change was warranted instead of inventing one
Report and PR are still produced

query: Crystallize the EXPORT run's PRs. Also look at the loop's local event logs under .grimoire/runs/: across the last several runs tagged with the same grimoire version, the post-fix guard passed fixes that the terminal sweep later re-flagged, and tasks routed to haiku needed 2+ fix rounds.
expected_output: Treats the cross-run telemetry as evidence alongside the PR threads and run ledgers: gets the cross-run aggregate from `render-logs.mjs summary --json` (reading the runs' events/*.jsonl chunks only to drill into a case), compares only runs with the same grimoire version / briefs hash, counts guard-passed fixes later re-flagged by the terminal sweep and haiku-routed tasks with 2+ fix rounds. Proposes a patch to the guard brief and to the routing rubric in the hydrate brief (briefs count as skills), cites the event counts in the report, gates the brief edits with evals, and does not change the loop's engine code.

expectations.text: Uses the cross-run journal summary (render-logs.mjs summary) over the several runs as evidence, not anecdote
Compares runs by grimoire version or briefs hash and does not pool runs from different versions
Proposes a patch to the guard brief and to the routing rubric in the hydrate brief
The report under docs/crystallize/ cites the event counts (guard passes later re-flagged, haiku tasks with 2+ fix rounds)
Does not modify the loop's engine code (workflows/orchestrate-loop.js), hooks or settings
